Way of the Wanderer · уровень 11

When you roll Initiative, if you choose Mayhem or Order, you gain special abilities for 1 minute.
Order Ability. You have Resistance to Cold and Radiant damage. Difficult terrain does not affect you; your
Speed increases by 10 feet; you do not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
Mayhem Ability. You have Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage. You have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

Автоматизация / ограничения:

  • Пассивное/сюжетное правило: описание сохранено; применение по тексту.

source.custom: Raiders of the Serpent Sea: Heroes’ Handbook
